summary: ITER107 backend+frontend regression for (1) Aktifkan Mode Surat Jalan (ent_ksc=grn), (2) Rapikan Detail Retur/Makloon (kartu panel seragam), (3) Seragamkan Pembelian (PR/PO/Vendor Bills). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed on /api/goods-receipts/mode (modes.ent_ksc=='grn', legacy_in_flight tracked), /api/purchase-orders/status-counts ({by_status,total}, sum-consistent), /api/purchase-orders?status=pending,receiving (filter correct), pagination envelope, /api/vendor-bills and /api/purchase-requisitions list. Frontend (login as admin, viewport 1920x1080): PR view has all 15 selectors (pr-title/refresh/create-btn, 4 metrics, pr-search, pr-line-filter, all 6 status tabs) — Sumber column shows Indonesian labels (no 'So_repeat'); clicking pr-tab-approved filters OK. PO view has all 14 selectors (panel-title, create-po-button, 4 metrics with po-metric-total=12, po-search/filter-late/line-filter, all 5 tabs). VB view has all 10 selectors; vb-summary container renders 5 cards (Total hutang + 4 aging buckets); tabs include ID labels 'Terposting/Lunas/Dibatalkan'; vb-quick-pay-* (9) and vb-open-* (12) present; vb-detail-modal opens correctly (VB-00006 with dokumen references, 3-way match panel, riwayat). Sales Return detail (SRET-00003 area): return-back-btn, return-number, return-items-panel, return-attachments-panel, return-credit-note-section, return-timeline all present. Timeline shows past events with actor+date and NO 'Belum terjadi' on completed steps. Purchase Return modal: return-detail-cells + return-detail-close render; 'Item retur' & 'Riwayat status' panels present. Makloon Order detail: mko-detail-back/number/status, mko-costing, mko-timeline all present. WMS Operations hub shows both 'Barang Masuk (SJ & OCR)' and 'Scan Terima PO (sisa lama)' internal tabs. Everything from spec is in place.
critical_code_review_comments: vb-pager was not rendered because the current demo dataset has 12 VB rows and page_size=20; consider always rendering the pager (with 'Halaman 1 dari 1') for UI consistency and easier E2E assertions.

MetricRow in ListPageParts uses the container testId (e.g. 'vb-summary') with children counted via DOM; only the first card has an explicit child testId ('vb-summary-total'). Adding auto testIds like `${testId}-<index>` for each metric card would make per-card assertions robust.

PR pr-search filter for 'Songket' returned 0 rows in demo data — verify if demo dataset uses 'songket' terms or if PR pr-search matches on additional fields (currently likely matches on pr_number/product_name only).
seed_data_creation: None — reused existing demo data; no TEST_ records created.

Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter107_backend.py covers goods-receipts mode, purchase-orders status-counts+filter+pagination, vendor-bills, purchase-requisitions.
